limitations: Snapshot next-day publication assumption; historical corrections cannot be undone.
Missing minutes are unknown; nonzero-boxscore probability is not availability.
Current NBA roles unknown; no verified future schedule, no actual seven-day totals.
Conditional moment calibration has no coverage or matchup-probability guarantee.
Player-cluster intervals do not remove common calendar shocks.
Ablations are development diagnostics, not selected on final outcomes.

protocol.calibration: chronologically later whole primitive-count residual factors, conditional on origin-known minutes/history; minimum 100 per cell, otherwise minute group then pooled; normalized positive factors plus Poisson noise; no holdout calibration
protocol.context: only lagged player and last-observed-team history; target team/opponent/home/lineup/status/minutes never used as features; no verified future schedule
protocol.eligibility: all historical players with >=1 origin-known prior row, across seasons; zero rows retained; no membership or positive-count filter
protocol.holdout_policy: freeze code/config/data and development selection/calibration before consume_holdout; no alternate selection or retuning after opening; retain guard and saved report
protocol.minutes_missingness: blank minutes remain unknown, not imputed to zero; source blank-minute rows have all zero counts; nonzero-row probability is a box-score proxy, not availability
protocol.production_policy: recency registry unchanged unless selected challenger passes frozen holdout gate; all-history refit remains explicitly versioned; no automatic retraining; no Yahoo
protocol.selection: lowest mean relative MAE over seven count categories plus FG%/FT%, relative to fixed recency14 on pooled development folds; tie by label; ablations diagnostic only
